title: fix(mail): sanitize CRLF in JMAP email/set article headers
description: create_one_email in mail/email/set.rs builds an RFC 5322 article via format!() with subject, from_email, and newsgroups inserted directly without stripping \r or \n. An authenticated JMAP client can inject arbitrary headers into articles stored in IPFS. Fix: strip or reject \r\n in subject, from_email, and each newsgroups entry before interpolating.
